craft_notes: Sthāyin: void-pair. Sanskrit: pṛṣṭaśūnyaṃ mūlaśūnyaṃ yugapad bhāvayec ca yaḥ...śūnyamanā bhavet → L4 keeps pair + agent + result. Rows: row 3 (power→void-minded). Close: may be (optative throughout — permission not command). Rejected: 'coccyx' — killed: back kept; 'ego-death' — killed: void-minded kept (mānas as mind-substance).

lines: Back-void, root-void at once contemplated, who so —
by body-disregarding power, void-minded may be.
l4.sanskrit_cite: pṛṣṭaśūnyaṃ mūlaśūnyaṃ yugapad bhāvayec ca yaḥ | śarīranirapekṣiṇyā śaktyā śūnyamanā bhavet

reads_against.argmap: Which voids are contemplated? → Contemplating back- and root-voids through body-disregard, one becomes void-minded.
c1_essence: Back, root voids contemplated: body-disregard, void-minded.
